title: The Two Doors
text: Two doors in a hillside, one guarded by a knight who always lies and one by a knight who never does. The usual riddle. The knights look bored. Their armor is very old, and nothing moves behind their visors.

options.label: The wisest asks the riddle's question, as it has always been asked.

outcomes.text: The right door, a short way, and the knights clap politely.

options.label: Fight your way past the nearer knight. Riddles are for the bored.

outcomes.text: They are not bored any more.

options.label: The Leader picks a door at random, and trusts to luck.
